    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_nakayama_approximation (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (T : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)) {P B : FGModuleCat R} [Module.Projective R ↑P] (a : P ⟶ B) (ha : ∀ (Y : FGModuleCat R), T Y → ∀ (f : P ⟶ Y), ∃ (b : B ⟶ Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a b = f) :
    ∃ (C : FGModuleCat R) (p : C ⟶ nakayamaObject k P), (∀ (Y : FGModuleCat R), T Y → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ C), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f p = 0) ∧ ∀ (Y : FGModuleCat R), rightHomOrthogonal B Y → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ nakayamaObject k P), ∃ (t : Y ⟶ C), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp t p = f

    Dualizing a projective presentation of a left approximation produces a map into the Nakayama module. Maps from the orthogonal factor through it, and its composites from the approximating class vanish.
